name: Anti-Ragging Committee
purpose: To ensure 100% ragging-free campus environment in strict adherence to UGC Regulations on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions and Hon'ble Supreme Court of India directives.
procedure: Any student subjected to or observing ragging incidents must immediately contact any committee member, drop a complaint in the Anti-Ragging Box, or email directly. Immediate inquiry and disciplinary/legal action will be initiated within 24 hours.

name: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
purpose: Constituted under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 and UGC guidelines to provide a safe, respectful, and gender-sensitized work and study environment for female students and staff.
helpline: College ICC Office / Women Helpline: 1090 (UP State Helpline)
procedure: An aggrieved woman can submit a written or electronic complaint to the Presiding Officer within 3 months of the incident. The committee maintains strict confidentiality throughout formal inquiry procedures.

name: Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC)
purpose: Formed as per UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations to address concerns regarding admissions, examinations, evaluation, facilities, harassment, or financial concessions in a transparent and fair manner.
procedure: Students may submit grievances in writing to the Principal's office or via the official online grievance form. The committee conducts periodic reviews and issues resolutions within 15 working days.

name: Right to Information (RTI) Cell
purpose: Established in compliance with the Right to Information Act, 2005 to promote transparency, accountability, and citizen access to institutional information.
procedure: Indian citizens can seek information by submitting an application along with the prescribed statutory fee (postal order/demand draft/court fee stamp) addressed to the Public Information Officer (PIO).
